title: AI Content and the War for Your Attention

reader_summary.headline: Humans who are able to be creative and use AI tools correctly will have superpowers.
reader_summary.overview: Humans who are able to be creative and use AI tools correctly will have superpowers. Does AI so ruthlessly optimize for that former, what you will pay attention to? It totally alienates you from the latter once you want to pay attention to.

key_points.text: Acquisition and retention are different things, right?

key_points.text: AI is going to upstream everything about consumer experience.
key_points.evidence_quote: AI is going to upstream everything about consumer experience.

thesis: The discussion argues that AI will upstream everything about the consumer experience, creating a disconnect where algorithms ruthlessly optimize for what users will pay attention to while alienating them from what they want to pay attention to. This shift threatens to overwhelm the digital experience with 'AI slop,' challenging platforms to move beyond simple attention acquisition to the more difficult task of retention.
